selection.rationale: Strategy-local MACE geometry optimization history shows strong convergence and small atomic displacements (<0.8 A) in size tiers 2, 4, and 8 when using aflow_prototype/aflow_vacancy and high-symmetry space groups (sg75-230), whereas all prior tier 16 and tier 32 actions failed to converge (0/24). Specifically, 3a5c87f7accb7740 (TaO2 tier 4 high-symmetry aflow_prototype), cd682c6633b66c28 (NbO2 tier 4 high-symmetry pyxtal), fa8b6920ffa21b02 (Nb2O5 tier 8 strained aflow_prototype), and 4042184642def540 (Ta2O4 tier 2 unstrained aflow_vacancy) each achieved 2/2 convergence with distinct final geometries, and 63332547fc97ff60 (NbTaO4 tier 8 high-symmetry aflow_prototype) achieved 1/2 convergence. We therefore concentrate 58/64 allocations across tiers 2 (18), 4 (24), and 8 (16) by exploiting these proven actions alongside their untested high-symmetry unstrained prototype/vacancy counterparts across TaO2, NbO2, NbTaO4, Nb2O5, Ta2O5, Nb2O4, and Ta2O4 within shared capacity limits. For tiers 16 (4) and 32 (2), we satisfy tier minimums conservatively using untested unstrained high-symmetry aflow_prototype actions in TaO2, NbO2, and NbTaO4 to maximize convergence probability at larger cell sizes.
